comparison.objective: Toss diced potato pieces to turn them while retaining them in a pan; candidate separates media from washers into different retained regions.
comparison.physical_skill: Both manipulate many loose bodies through controlled container motion, but pan tossing intentionally launches and reorients all pieces while screening selectively passes smaller bodies through apertures.
comparison.success_condition: At least seven dice turned, none lost for full score, pan returned and released for 1 s; candidate requires ≥98% media passage, all washers retained, screen reseated, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: This is the closest dynamic-container comparison, yet orientation-changing ballistic tossing does not test size-selective aperture passage and simultaneous two-class retention.
